formal_research_unit: C3X 0.14 — Transportable Search-Mechanism Evidence, Chess-Concept Mediation & Faithful Explanation Systems
user_governance: Pn checkpoints are sections inside ONE C3X 0.14 phase, not independent formal research stages or Notion pages.

native_toolchain.conditions: Original SF16/CLEAN, EP9 OFF/ONE_MAIN/MAIN with native completedDepth and search path instrumentation. Source game/fen/white pawn pair fixed. Threads1 Hash16MiB MultiPV2 go depth12 cold engine process.
native_toolchain.native_semantics: TTEntry occupies 10 bytes, 3 entries per 32 byte cluster; native entry stores key lower16 only, cluster via mul_hi64(fullkey, clusterCount). Separate pointer-keyed sidecar captures last successful FULLFIELD writer full 64bit key, writer class and sequence; not a change to actual TTEntry size. The six native search.cpp TTEntry::save paths are class-labelled.
native_toolchain.surgical_one_return_site: First dynamically eligible main TT bound early-return event after native safeguards incl rule50<90; score and move sorting history updates before return remain; ONE_MAIN suppresses only first such return.

actual_run.source_caveat: A complete 64bit writer-consumer match in sidecar is not proof of no hash collisions elsewhere. Sidecar tracks last fullfield save into concrete physical slot, not all prior search-value ancestry or why writer computed cached score. All examples from same development TCEC ecology; cold technical repeats not independent.

failed_runs_and_repairs.root_cause: Prior frozen JSON MultiPV ranks stored object keys '1','2', live parsed UCI dictionaries use integer indices 1,2. Rank nodes/cp/PV identical but key types compared falsely unequal. Failed closed before result.
Print inspection showed all UCI numbers and PV strings identical; only Python int vs JSON string rank map keys differ.

failed_runs_and_repairs.phase: Succeeded after strict canonical dictionary-key-only normalization
failed_runs_and_repairs.note: No weakening of PV move/node/score/bound equality or native counters; full grid replayed.

scientific_limits: Writer class 4 MAIN_TERMINAL for all 28 FIRST consumers is a fact about first blocked eligible returned entries in selected worlds, not a statement that all engine TT entries originate at terminal store.
All 28 first consumer keys match last full-field writers; other TT entries/collisions may differ.

Label 'move_only' in first sidecar implementation operationally denotes calls with no fullfield write, and can include a no-op when no move bytes are assigned; do not count as literal move16 mutations without a followup recorder correction.
Same chess concept feature vectors across distinct black-move worlds do not imply same exact TT event or transposition key.
Direct software intervention ONE_MAIN is validated for local output; exact separate causal mechanisms of LMR/history/move order/NNUE/alpha-beta and chess semantic strategy not yet identified.
Native SF16 TTEntry::save updated without modifying native TTEntry 10byte layout. Passive recorder may change runtime performance under time control; only fixed depth and strict replay tested.
